title: Russia lacks technical capacity to repair Crimean Bridge – Pletenchuk
summary: Russia currently lacks the technical capacity needed to repair the Kerch Strait Bridge. The alternatives for travel to temporarily occupied Crimea remain a land route through the occupied territories of the Azov region and ferry crossings.

title: Bringing equipment repairs closer to front line: NATO and Ukraine developing enhanced repair centers
summary: NATO and Ukraine are developing a concept for enhanced repair centers that would bring industrial and logistical capabilities closer to the front line, enabling faster repairs and the quicker return of equipment to the battlefield.

title: 54% of damaged healthcare infrastructure facilities restored in Chernihiv region
summary: A total of 100 healthcare and social welfare facilities in Ukraine's Chernihiv region have been damaged by enemy shelling. So far, 54% of those facilities have been restored, while another 10% are being rebuilt.

title: Ukraine blocks Russian climate report containing data from occupied territories at COP31
summary: At the UN Climate Change Conference COP31 in Antalya, the Ukrainian delegation blocked consideration of an agenda item concerning Russia's inclusion of data from temporarily occupied Ukrainian territories in its climate reporting.

title: Russian colonel suspected of ordering use of chemical weapons against Ukrainian troops
summary: Law enforcement authorities have declared a Russian colonel a suspect over orders to use chemical weapons against Ukrainian military personnel.

title: Zelensky: Russia attacked Ukrainian bridges 109 times before Ukraine struck Kerch Bridge
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky said Russia had carried out 109 attacks on Ukrainian bridges before Ukraine launched a retaliatory operation against the Kerch Bridge.

title: Streeting: Putin’s attempts to divide Europe only strengthen its resolve to support Ukraine
summary: European countries are united in their support for Ukraine, and the more Russian leader Vladimir Putin tries to divide Europe and turn its allies away from supporting Ukraine, the more resolute they become. Ukraine’s frontline is also Europe’s frontline in the fight for freedom and democracy.

title: Zelensky thanks Streeting for Britain's ‘tangible steps’ in supporting Ukraine
summary: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky met with UK Secretary of State for Defence Wes Streeting. Before the meeting, the head of state thanked Britain for the aid package for Ukraine announced several days earlier.

title: DM Khmara says Russia will need several months to raise damaged section of Kerch Bridge
summary: Minister of Defense of Ukraine Yevhenii Khmara said Russia would need several months to raise the damaged section of the Kerch Bridge.

title: Von der Leyen condemns assassination attempt against U.S.-Ukrainian citizen in Denmark, pledges new EU security strategy
summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has strongly condemned an assassination plot against a U.S. and Ukrainian citizen in Denmark, allegedly orchestrated by Russian intelligence services, stressing that such actions by the Kremlin will only strengthen the European Union’s resolve to support Ukraine.

title: Ukrainian forces strike bridge, ammunition depot and Russian command posts
summary: On November 20 and overnight into November 21, Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck a bridge, an ammunition depot and command posts of the Russian military.

title: President, First Lady honor Heavenly Hundred Heroes at renovated memorial site
summary: On the Day of Dignity and Freedom, President Volodymyr Zelensky and First Lady Olena Zelenska paid tribute to the Ukrainians who were killed during the Revolution of Dignity at a renovated memorial site on the Alley of the Heavenly Hundred Heroes.

title: Russian forces hit industrial facility in Rivne region overnight, one person injured
summary: Russian forces attacked a civilian industrial facility in the Rivne region overnight on November 21, injuring one person.

title: Injury toll in Russian attacks on Kryvyi Rih rises to 60
summary: The number of people injured in Russian attacks on Kryvyi Rih has risen to 60, with 28 people remaining in hospital.

title: Russian forces strike civilian and energy infrastructure in Zhytomyr region, two people injured
summary: Two people, a local resident and a foreign national, were injured in Russian attacks on the Zhytomyr region.

title: Kyiv reports damage in three districts after morning Russian attack, two people injured
summary: Two people were injured in a Russian attack on Kyiv in the morning of November 21. Residential buildings were damaged in three districts, while water supply disruptions were reported in five districts.

title: Crimean bridge, which Putin uses to transport weapons, to not remain standing, Zelensky says
summary: Russian leader Vladimir Putin uses the Kerch Bridge to transport large quantities of military equipment to temporarily occupied Ukrainian territory. Therefore, the bridge "will not remain standing."

title: Russian attack in Vinnytsia region leaves one injured, business facility damaged
summary: A woman was injured in a Russian attack in the Vinnytsia region, while civilian facilities and vehicles were damaged.

title: War update: 203 combat engagements on front line over past day, most in Pokrovsk direction
summary: A total of 203 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line on November 20.

title: Russian attacks in Sumy region leaves three injured over past day
summary: Three civilians were injured in Russian attacks in the Sumy region over the past 24 hours.

title: Air defense neutralizes 117 of 148 Russian drones launched against Ukraine overnight
summary: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 117 of the 148 drones launched by Russian forces against Ukraine since the evening of November 20.

title: Russian forces attack Dnipropetrovsk region nearly 10 times since evening: Two killed, 55 injured
summary: Since the evening of November 20, Russian forces have attacked five districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region nearly 10 times using drones and missiles. Two people were killed and 55 injured. Children were among both the victims and the injured.

title: Injury toll after Russian attacks in Kharkiv region rises to 11, including two children
summary: The number of people injured in Russian attacks in the Kharkiv region has risen to 11, including two children.

title: Russian army loses another 1,730 personnel, two air defense systems in war against Ukraine
summary: Russia's total combat losses since the beginning of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, through November 21, 2026, are estimated at approximately 1,634,860 personnel, including 1,730 over the past 24 hours.

title: More than 50 settlements without electricity in Sarny district following Russian attack
summary: More than 50 settlements in the Sarny district of the Rivne region have been left without electricity following a Russian attack. Ongoing air raid alerts are preventing repair crews from quickly addressing the damage.

title: Russia unlikely to increase traffic on Kerch Bridge even after repairs – Pletenchuk
summary: Even if restoration work is carried out on the railway section of the Kerch Bridge, Russia is unlikely to risk increasing the load on it.

title: Kindergarten hit in Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia, man injured
summary: A kindergarten was hit in a Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia. An elderly man was injured, and a fire broke out in a neighboring residential building.

title: Russia launches another attack on Kryvyi Rih, fire breaks out at industrial facility
summary: Russian forces have launched another drone attack on Kryvyi Rih, sparking a fire at an industrial facility.

title: 'To us, he is enemy and murderer': Zelensky on Putin, whom Trump called friend
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he considers Russian dictator Vladimir Putin a murderer and an enemy of Ukraine, after US President Donald Trump referred to Putin as his friend.

title: Rain expected across Ukraine today, temperatures up to 14°C
summary: Light rain is expected across Ukraine on Saturday, November 21, with wind gusts reaching up to 20 m/s.

title: Russia launches up to 200 attack drones nightly and more than 100 during the day – Ihnat
summary: Russian forces are attacking Ukraine with strike drones virtually around the clock, launching more than 100 during the day and up to 200 at night. On some days, jet-powered UAVs account for as much as 95% of the total.
